passages.quote:
As an employer, reimbursing or paying your employees’ bank charges counts as earnings.

You will need to:

add the payments to your employees’ other earnings

deduct and pay PAYE tax and Class 1 National Insurance through payroll

What’s exempt

If your employees’ bank charges are your fault (for example, because you paid their wages late) and you pay or reimburse them, this does not count as earnings.

You will not need to report anything to HM Revenue and Customs (HMRC) or pay any tax or National Insurance.

Technical guidance
